hook.title: ALOHA AIRLINES FLIGHT 243
lines: At 24,000 feet, a large section of roof tears completely off a Boeing 737-200.
One crew member dies and 65 passengers and crew are injured.
The failure began at a cold-bonded lap joint on an airframe flown 89,680 times.
